values.description: Dwarka is a coastal pilgrimage town associated with Krishna. Its principal sites include the Dwarkadhish temple, Rukmini temple and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, with Bet Dwarka offshore near Okha.

records.notes: Paraphrased district visitor information.

values.description: The Dwarkadhish temple is a Krishna pilgrimage shrine in Dwarka, also known as Jagat Mandir.
values.best_time_note: Darshan has a midday closure; published guide gives 06:30-13:00 and 17:00-21:30. Accessibility guide reports assisted entry via the exit side and a step near the sanctum; independent wheelchair access is not established.

records.notes: Mapped temple anchor; boolean remains unknown because access is partial and assisted. Existing continuous scheduling window cannot encode the midday closure.

values.description: Nageshwar is a Shiva temple in the Dwarka area, traditionally counted among the twelve Jyotirlingas.
values.best_time_note: Accessibility guide reports rear entrance access and steep ramps requiring assistance. Wheelchair darshan is from an elevated area with restricted sightlines; direct access to the Jyotirlinga is unavailable.

records.notes: Exact selected business coordinates archived in pages/nageshwar-map.json. Corrects inaccurate legacy longitude. Access guide is authored firsthand disability guidance, not an inference from photographs.

values.description: The Rukmini temple near Dwarka is dedicated to Krishna's consort and features carved exterior walls.
values.best_time_note: Disability travel guide reports steps and uneven paths preventing wheelchair access.

records.notes: Corrects legacy coordinates; accessibility supported by a dedicated authored accessibility guide.

values.entry_fee: Free general temple admission; transport and optional services extra
values.description: Bet Dwarka is an island near Okha associated with Krishna. This itinerary point is anchored at Shri Beyt Dwarkadhish Temple.
values.best_time_note: Road access is available over Sudarshan Setu, inaugurated in February 2024. Ferry is optional; no verified current ferry tariff is stored. Temple hours vary and include a midday closure. Accessibility guide reports steps near the sanctum requiring lifting assistance.

records.notes: Exact selected temple coordinates archived pages/bet-dwarka-selected.json. Free admission cross-checked in two secondary visitor sources, neither represented as an official temple tariff. Does not treat boat fare as admission. Conflicting published hours not used to overwrite legacy hours. Bridge source is official PIB.
